svg.title: Instances solved within a time limit, MCC 2020–2026 track 1, decision-diagram compilation in memory, 120 s
svg.desc: Cactus plot: for each solver, the number of instances solved (vertical) within a time (horizontal, linear, up to 120 s). tididi-cnf solves 710; OxiDD solves 153; BuDDy solves 157; CUDD (static) solves 144; Sylvan (static) solves 142; lib-bdd solves 146; SDD (fixed) solves 93; SDD (dynamic) solves 128.
